vuln.name: Cookies Not Marked as HttpOnly
vuln.description: One or more cookies don't have the HttpOnly flag set. When a cookie is set with the HttpOnly flag, it instructs the browser that the cookie can only be accessed by the server and not by client-side scripts. This is an important security protection for session cookies.
vuln.impact: Cookies can be accessed by client-side scripts.
vuln.recommendation: If possible, you should set the HttpOnly flag for these cookies.
